comparison.objective: Swap two failed fans in a running fan wall one bay at a time; candidate commissions and locks a compact damper with the axis isolated during adjustment.
comparison.physical_skill: Live-service sequencing, fan-module release/removal/insertion, and continuity preservation versus fine tool seating, counterholding, collar tuning, locking, and dynamic-response evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Both failed fans replaced without taking multiple bays offline versus two safe repeated carriage stops with retained setting. PR body, specs, thermal/continuity thresholds, and failure rubric are absent.
comparison.reason: Hot-swap maintenance and service-continuity sequencing do not evaluate damping adjustment, despite both being industrial maintenance.
